input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: dollies in slow — the framing grows steadily tighter on the subject. Moderate amplitude, spread evenly over the full 5 seconds. Subjects: subject 1: "brushes dust off the tin can and exhales" — a small, restrained movement. Pace the motion across the full 5-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. After brushing off the dust, a dented tin can is revealed. The girl exhales a ragged breath mixed with exhausted disappointment.

Camera choreography, one move: this shot has exactly one camera move — a slow dolly in that pushes straight toward the girl and the dented tin can she is holding. The camera starts at the framing of the start image, standing off far enough to hold her head, her shoulders and the whole can, then travels forward along its own axis at a slow, even rate so the framing grows steadily tighter, until by the final frame the can and her hands fill noticeably more of the frame than they did at the start. First the framing is the wide one of the start image; then the push forward begins, and while it runs she brushes the dust off the can and exhales. Once the push has begun nothing else changes — no pan, no tilt, no lateral track, no orbit, no crane, no change of height or roll, and the push never stops or reverses — and it continues unbroken through the final frame.

jobs.label: 계약 없음 — 기본 모션 계약문 + 순서형 안무 블록

input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: LOCKED tripod shot — absolutely zero camera movement for the entire clip: no pan, no drift, no zoom, no push-in. Subjects: environment: lighting flicker (moderate). Pace the motion across the full 8-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. Static wide shot of the office before the intrusion; dust particles drift through shafts of sunlight.. shot on Arri Alexa, 35mm, f/2.8, white balance 5600K

Camera choreography, one move: this shot has no camera move at all — the single instruction is to hold. The camera is locked off on a tripod at the framing of the start image and that framing is held exactly, edge for edge, from the first frame to the last: the same lens, the same height, the same distance, the same window mullions cutting the frame in the same places, the same dark desk edge across the bottom. First the frame is exactly the start image; then it simply stays that frame. Nothing travels — no pan, no tilt, no dolly, no push-in, no drift, no orbit, no crane, no zoom, no roll, no reframing of any kind — the only things that change inside the locked frame are the dust drifting in the light and the flicker of the light itself, and the final frame is still the same framing as the first.

input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: tracks steady with the subject toward deeper into the scene (background flows toward past the camera). Moderate amplitude, spread evenly over the full 5 seconds. Subjects: subject 1: "walks away" — a large, clearly visible movement that completes fully; gaze turns from char 2 to forward. Pace the motion across the full 5-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. Jung Su-rim fixes Kim Yo-han with an icy stare, then steers Cho Seung-woo swiftly into the courthouse.

Camera choreography, one move: this shot has exactly one camera move — a steady forward track that follows the two figures deeper into the courthouse entrance. The camera stays behind them at the same height and travels straight ahead at their own walking pace, keeping them the same size in the middle of the frame while the stone pillars and the glass doors ahead grow larger and slide past the edges of the frame toward the camera. First the framing is exactly the start image, with the two backs in the centre and the man standing at screen left; then the forward travel begins and the pair walk away into the building as the camera keeps following. Once the travel has begun nothing else changes — no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no crane, no lateral drift, no zoom, no change of height or roll — and the forward track continues unbroken through the final frame.

input.prompt:
Motion contract: Camera: tracks slow with the subject toward screen left (background flows toward screen right). Moderate amplitude, spread evenly over the full 5 seconds. Subjects: subject 1: "steps forward" — a clear movement that completes. Pace the motion across the full 5-second duration — by the final frame every scripted movement has fully completed. Do NOT add any camera movement, framing change, new character, new prop or extra action beyond this contract.. Kim Yo-han adjusts his glasses and looks Cho Seung-woo up and down; Jung Su-rim steps forward to block him.

Camera choreography, one move: this shot has exactly one camera move — a slow lateral track that travels toward screen left. The camera stays at the same eye-level height and the same distance from the group on the courthouse steps and slides steadily toward screen left at a slow, even walking pace, so the stone columns and the ranked press photographers behind the figures stream from screen left to screen right across the frame. First the framing is exactly the start image, with the out-of-focus man in the black suit filling the left foreground; then the lateral slide begins, and while it runs the woman in the navy suit steps forward between the men. Once the slide has begun nothing else changes — no push-in, no orbit, no crane, no tilt, no change of height, distance or roll — and the lateral track continues unbroken through the final frame.
